name: Shamshrai
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Shamshrai is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Jeroham, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem. He belonged to one of the families that settled in Jerusalem after returning from exile in Babylon. His role is primarily genealogical within the lists of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shamshirai is listed as one of the sons of Jeroham in the genealogy of the Benjamites who settled in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Settlement of the Benjamites in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Shamshirai was among the family heads from the tribe of Benjamin living in Jerusalem, and he is recorded among the leading families.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: The complete genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin is given in 1 Chronicles, where Shamshirai is placed within the context of the tribe's history.

keyEvents.title: Family Heads in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shamshirai and his brothers are counted among the family heads of the tribe of Benjamin, indicating a certain leadership role within the tribe.
